THE WORK AROUND THE MODEL

A capable model is
only part of the job.

Reliable work also depends on the right information, tools, rules and checks.

01 / CONTEXT

A new batch of data changes the result.

Make sources, task context and tool use part of the system, rather than stitching them together each time.

02 / QUALITY

The workflow runs. Is the output usable?

Turn a good result into something you can check: business constraints, representative examples and review criteria.

03 / FEEDBACK

The same mistake needs fixing again.

Use failures and human feedback to propose changes, then evaluate them independently before adoption.

TWO DISTINCT LOOPS

One does the work.
One improves how it is done.

A harness is the execution system around a model. It determines which information and tools are available, how the task proceeds and how the result is checked.

Run→Task / execution / checks
Improve→Feedback / evaluation / approval
